title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center Arena on 1973-03-28

ai_review.summary: A superb matrix mix that delivers an immersive, crystal‑clear listening experience of the 1973 show, with reviewers raving about its vivid sound despite no specific musical details being mentioned.
ai_review.review: Listeners praise this sbd + audience matrix for its striking clarity and the way it transports you to the venue, calling the blend “in disbelief” and a “great Matrix patch.” While the reviews contain no concrete comments on individual songs or band performance, the enthusiastic tone and high star ratings indicate overall satisfaction with both the show and its recording.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave high marks (4–5 stars) and highlighted the exceptional matrix sound; lacking detailed musical commentary, the rating leans on recording quality while assuming an average‑to‑good performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe a seamless blend of soundboard and audience (“Cumberland patch to the Aud”), noting crisp, immersive audio that makes listeners feel present at the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or song flow; reviewers expressed general enthusiasm for the performance.
